lines.zh: 我一步一步走过来，盔甲在响。
lines.en: I walk over, armor clinking.
No one is walking inside it.
I'm an empty suit of armor.
My boots strike the flagstones.
I walk steady, not fast.

lines.zh: 这把剑在我手里拖着地。
lines.en: The sword drags on the ground in my grip.

lines.zh: 盔甲里没有人，脚步却稳。
lines.en: No one's inside, yet the steps stay steady.
Dark shows between the plates.

lines.zh: 我转身的时候，关节咔的一声。
lines.en: My joints click when I turn.
I don't cast a shadow.
I can't speak, only walk.

lines.zh: 我的靴底把石板磨得发亮。
lines.en: My boot soles polish the flagstones.
I stand, the armor perfectly still.
The sword tip rests on the ground.
I raise the bow.
The string makes no sound.

lines.zh: 这身甲本来是别人穿的。
lines.en: This armor was worn by someone else.
Now it walks on its own.
I nock an arrow.

lines.zh: 石板上有我留下的暗影。
lines.en: A dark stain lies on the stones where I stand.
The empty helm sways slightly in the wind.
I wait for you to come within three steps.

lines.zh: 甲里是空的，可我知道你在哪。
lines.en: The armor's empty, but I know where you are.
I shift the sword's angle.
I ease the bowstring a little.
No wind in the cave, yet the plates are cold.
I drive my sword into a crack in the stone.
I count the number of your breaths.
You're staring at my helm.

lines.zh: 头盔深处只有更深的黑。
lines.en: Only deeper black inside the helm.
Want to wear it yourself?
This armor won't fit you.
I lift the sword a little.
You stepped back.
I can count your steps.
Inside empty armor, I move.
I lower the bow.
The sword is simpler.
You wear no armor.
That's good for me.
Inside empty armor, I raise a bow.
I glance at your weapon.
You hit my armor.
A plate dented.
It's empty inside. No pain.
A plate shifted back a notch.
That made me sway.

lines.zh: 凹进去的甲片自己弹回。
lines.en: The dented plate springs back on its own.
The sword is still in my hand.
Your knuckles are hard enough.
One clank of armor — a joint.
I'm still standing.
Leaving it on the ground won't help.
There isn't even a throat in here.
There's no mouth in this armor.
I can't take these.
Holding it up makes you look foolish.
One reach and I have you.
Just drop it.
These mean nothing to an empty shell.
I slowly raise the sword.
You can't outrun my bow.
The plate bounces you backward.
The plate dents; I don't budge.

lines.zh: 盔甲里发出空空的响声。
lines.en: A hollow sound comes from inside.
Don't press against my plates.
A plate caught you.
We both hit the stone pillar.
The pillar cracked.

lines.zh: 你退到自己踩的影子里。
lines.en: You stepped back into your own shadow.
My plates scrape together.
Another try bounces off the same.
There's no one inside this armor.
Why do you ask?

lines.zh: 我连自己是谁都不记得。
lines.en: I don't even remember who I was.
This armor doesn't know such things.
There's nobody inside this armor.
I only know one thing.
And then I act.
Only echoes inside the plates.
You'd best leave this wall.
I have nothing else to say.
I flick it up off the ground.
One hook of the blade is enough.
You dropped it? Mine.
An empty gauntlet can't hold a thing.
These gauntlets feel nothing.
Toss it aside.
This isn't a sword.
The arrow went through a gap in my armour.
It has a shadow on the flagstones.
I don't.
Your feet are planted there — perfect.
I've found you.
The bow comes up first.
This arrow will leave quietly.
You can't dodge.
I'm measuring you to the wall.
Wind doesn't affect me.
The plates don't tremble.
I draw the string slowly.
This armor has killed before.
And so it does now.
I raise my bow and aim at the back of your knee.
I draw the string to its stop.
Before my sword reaches you.

lines.zh: 你拐过柱子，我也拐过去。
lines.en: You round the pillar; I round it too.
The armor's steps land heavy.
You ran behind a pillar.
I changed my angle.
In the hollow armor, the bow is drawn full.
You peeked from the other side.
I see you.
The flagstones ring under me.
You backed to the wall.
My plates scrape along the wall corner.
My sword stays lowered.
That's for close quarters.
You're counting my steps.
You can't keep up.
At this end of the corridor, there's only me.
The sword slashes across.
You raise your shield to block.

lines.zh: 甲片撞在盾上，响了一声。
lines.en: The plates rang against your shield.
My point slides off your pauldron.
This one goes for your ribs.
You twisted away.
I follow with a shoulder.
You fell back a full two steps.
The sword tip scraped your armor.
An inch more and it would have gone in.

lines.zh: 盔甲在墙角自己站了起来。
lines.en: The armor stood up by itself in the corner.
The plates clicked into place.
The helm is empty.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，剑已经在里面。
lines.en: I lift a hand, and the sword is already in it.

lines.zh: 石板上有我落脚的声音。
lines.en: My boots sound on the flagstones.
I have no origin.
I have walked the caves beyond the river.
There's no one there.
I turn the sword point down.
Now there is someone here.
I lower my helm toward you.
I sling the bow behind me.
A soft sound comes from inside the armor.
I take one step toward you.
Fire baked the plates until they glowed.

lines.zh: 从台阶上滚下来，甲片散了一地。
lines.en: I rolled down the steps and plates scattered.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲里，我沉得很快。
lines.en: Water filled the armor and I sank fast.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，甲片崩开。
lines.en: The blast knocked me over and plates burst apart.
Another arrow, lodged in my plate.

lines.zh: 光穿过甲片，我的动作慢了一拍。
lines.en: Light passed through the plates and my motion slowed.
I don't eat, and I can't starve.

lines.zh: 电顺着甲片走，我抖了一下。
lines.en: The current ran along the plates and I twitched.

lines.zh: 甲片在虚空里慢慢散开。
lines.en: My plates slowly come apart in the void.
